title.zh: 修订第720号共和国法第14条（即《农村银行法》）的法案
title.en: An Act to Amend Section Fourteen of Republic Act Numbered Seven Hundred Twenty, Otherwise Known as the Rural Banks’ Act
title.orig: An Act to Amend Section Fourteen of Republic Act Numbered Seven Hundred Twenty, Otherwise Known as the Rural Banks’ Act

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3128_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section fourteen of Republic Act Numbered Seven hundred twenty, otherwise known as the Rural Banks’ Act, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 14. All Rural Banks created and organized under the provisions of this Act, with net assets not exceeding seven hundred thousand pesos, excluding the counterpart capital subscribed and paid in by the government under sections seven and eight of this Act, shall be exempt from the payment of all taxes, charges and fees of whatever nature and description."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1961.
